title: Headlights
alg: R U' L' U R' U' L
then: L' U' L U' L' U2 L
rec: Find a side whose two top corners are the same colour (headlights) and hold it on the right. This always leaves a fish: solve it with the left sune and the corners are done.

title: No headlights
alg: R U' L' U R' U' L
then: L' U' L U' L' U2 L U2 R U' L' U R' U' L L' U' L U' L' U2 L
rec: No side has matching corners. Do it from any angle and solve the fish with the left sune. You'll then have headlights.

title: One edge solved
alg: R U R' U R U2 R' U L' U' L U' L' U2 L U'
rec: A sune, then a left sune. Turn the top so the corners match the sides, then hold the solved side at the back.

title: One edge solved, other way
alg: R U R' U R U2 R' U L' U' L U' L' U2 L U'
rec: Same as before, but the edges need to go the other way. Do it twice.

title: No edges solved
alg: R U R' U R U2 R' U L' U' L U' L' U2 L U'
then: U' R U R' U R U2 R' U L' U' L U' L' U2 L U'
rec: Do it once from any angle and one edge will be solved. Then do the one-edge case.
